<tool_call>
<function=analyze_supply_chain>
<parameter=content>
A mid-size apparel company uses cotton sourced from multiple countries, relying on third-party logistics providers for transportation. They operate a single manufacturing plant in a coastal region prone to seasonal hurricanes, which then distributes to retailers across North America. The reliance on a sole factory and weather-vulnerable location along with international suppliers introduces risks.
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
